title: Prism Composition Primitives
description: Layer, concat, facet, and repeat composition operators.

spec_ref.description: Recursive reference back to the spec schema.

layer.description: Array of child specs drawn over the same coordinate space.

concat.description: Array of child specs concatenated in reading order.

hconcat.description: Array of child specs concatenated horizontally.

vconcat.description: Array of child specs concatenated vertically.

facet.description: Small-multiples facet: split data by row/column then apply the child spec.

cell_overrides.description: Sparse per-cell theme overrides, addressed by 0-based grid position.

repeat.description: Repeat the child spec across a set of field names.

layer.description: Fields to repeat as overlaid layers.

cell_overrides.description: Sparse per-cell theme overrides, addressed by 0-based grid position.
Sparse per-cell theme overrides for a facet/repeat grid, addressed by 0-based (row, column) grid position rather than by the data value that landed in the cell.

cell_theme_override.description: One cell's sparse theme override, addressed by 0-based grid position.

row.description: 0-based row index into the facet/repeat grid.

column.description: 0-based column index into the facet/repeat grid.

theme.description: Sparse theme override merged over the chart's resolved theme for this cell only.
